title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream — Episode5 To Make Them Smile

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Event Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
Emu's starting to feel lonely because she thinks that you guys are gonna split up soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Which is why we want to cheer her up somehow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, it's inevitable that we'll have to go our separate ways to pursue our dreams.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we're not sure how to talk to her about it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that may be tricky...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Regardless of what we say, it's up to Emu to come to terms with it by herself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By herself...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't wanna see Emu all sad and lonely!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We should do what we can to get her to smile like she usually does!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right...
I know how easy it is to fall deeper and deeper into this sort of abyss, so I'm very worried.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? I didn't know you were capable of feeling sad, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, what's that supposed to mean?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, our first step may be to help cheer her up by thinking of something that she can enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That she can enjoy...?
So, something that she likes doing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What does Emu like to do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Explore her neighborhood and going to taiyaki shops...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
She said that she really loves playing video games with you, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you two went shopping together the other day, she was as happy and talkative as ever☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You do seem to mean quite a lot to her, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That's just us being friends...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, what does Emu care about the most...? I've gone through a lot of possibilities in my head, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Wonder Stage and Phoenix Wonderland, no...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that may be our best option.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup yup! Especially since you guys are all there and mean the world to her☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, how about hanging out together with her at Phoenix Wonderland together...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, hanging out with the people I care most about somewhere I really love would definitely put a smile on my face!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Just thinking about doing that in SEKAI with everyone makes me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It makes me...super happy and excited☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you're saying...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we're there pretty much every day because of our shows... We wouldn't be going very far. You really believe that's going to make her feel better...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Regardless of what we say, it's up to Emu to come to terms with it by herself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, that may not be as bad an idea as it may sound...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But not great?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, Len, he's saying that it's a very good idea.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
So, I was able to help you two?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you gave us some wonderful advice. I'd like to ask Emu about this as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, wait. Nene, you may need to contact her since I have to stay here to help KAITO with his show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's fine...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Sorry, Rui.
I wish I could've picked a better time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's okay since you all helped us out just now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
Can we join you guys when you all hang out together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, sure. I'm sure Emu would like that too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks!
I really hope we can cheer Emu up and turn her frown upside down☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm excited about this too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But is this really gonna help cheer her up...?)
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “And so, the girl and her father looked up towards the boat-shaped cloud in the night sky, together.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd been a while since I last read this, but I still love it. It's like an exciting dream, but it's not a dream...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what if we put on a show based on this story...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A message?
From who? It's so late...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Nene!
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Sorry, I know this is sudden. But since we're gonna have some time to spare before Tsukasa's show, how would you feel about hanging out together at Phoenix Wonderland that day?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <We've been so busy lately that I think we deserve a little reward. Rui said he'll come, so let me know if you also want to.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This is great!
We get to hang out together at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What should we go on? The roller coaster for one. I also wanna go on the fish coaster, and at night...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're gonna see Tsukasa's show...
It's probably gonna be super duper amazing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Practicing at the Wonder Stage while attending that workshop has to be super hard, but he's managing really well. So well that he's been sparkling during practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, when we see Tsukasa in his super, ultra-powered up state...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm so scared...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Seeing that is going to be like a sign that we're gonna have to say goodbye to each other soon.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Because of that...
A part of me is having trouble rooting for Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really don't like that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean I'll start feeling the same way about the others...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... I...
